meta.name: WealthSmith Primitive Z-Index Tokens
meta.description: Raw z-index values for the WealthSmith design system. These tokens define the stacking scale used for layered UI elements.

raised.description: Raised content such as cards, sticky elements, or active surfaces

sticky.description: Sticky headers, sticky table headers, and pinned UI regions

navigation.description: Primary navigation, sidebar, and top navigation layers

dropdown.description: Dropdown menus, select menus, autocomplete panels, and popovers

overlay.description: Overlay scrims and temporary overlay backdrops

drawer.description: Drawers, side sheets, mobile navigation drawers, and Smith AI overlay panels

modal.description: Modals, dialogs, and blocking confirmation surfaces

toast.description: Toast notifications and transient system messages

system.description: Highest-priority system-level UI such as critical alerts
